verdict.rationale: Vercel documents Vercel Agent as an AI assistant built into Vercel. Users can delegate production-issue investigations, code review, and approved actions to it, and it can use secure sandboxes to reproduce issues and validate generated code. However, the documented surfaces (Slack chat, dashboard chat, Investigations, Code Review) are only in public beta and limited to Pro and Enterprise teams, which leaves the story's coverage partial. missing for 10: general availability across all plans, documented depth of which actions can be delegated and executed end-to-end, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
